name: Festival Stone of Verdantine
title: Festival Stone of Verdantine
summary: 'The Stone of Verdantine stands tall over the road leading southwest out of Samsur' (Alatar Locke); 'on the edge of a bluff and flanked by two Empyrean Statues' (acpedia). In the kit: the stone and its glow on the south-west corner of a flat bluff (z 60) between two 3 m candle sentinels, with the road valley 40 m below to the south and west.

landmarks.name: Festival Stone of Verdantine
landmarks.note: Festival Stone spawn with the Anniversary glow.

landmarks.name: Bluff
landmarks.note: Drops from 60 to 20 within 30 m south and 40 m west.

site.name: Festival Stone of Verdantine
site.notes: Teleport = gazetteer verdantine-festival-stone (bluff top, 12 m south-west of the stone).

shots.standingOrder: Arc 40 degrees round the south face of the bluff 34 m out and 10 m above the stone, holding the Festival Stone and its two sentinels on the rim; stay 25 m from the sentinels and 30 m above the slope, creatures may be faded.
shots.notes: Arc round the bluff on which the Festival Stone of Verdantine 'stands tall over the road leading south-west out of Samsur': the stone and its two candle sentinels hold on the rim as the camera sweeps 40 degrees 30-45 m above the drop; low morning sun from the east. shots.standingOrder: Back away north-east over the bluff top from 10 m to 55 m while zooming in so the stone and its sentinels hold their size and the road valley swells behind them; stay 4 m above the grass and 10 m from the sentinels.
shots.notes: Drone dolly-zoom on the stone: the camera backs off from 10 m to 55 m over the bluff top while the lens narrows, so the stone and sentinels keep their size and the road valley and the far plains swell behind them; morning sun behind the lens.
